title: Ethical Duty vs. Institutional Obligation
goal: Distinguish moral duty (deber, haber de), retrospective critique (debería haber) and legal requirement (tener que) in bioethics.

items: I can distinguish moral duty (*deber*, *haber de*) from external legal or institutional requirements (*tener que*).
I can use *debería haber* + past participle for retrospective ethical critique without confusing *deber* with *deber de*.
I can use core vocabulary for bioethics, ethics committees, confidentiality and conscientious objection.
